_comment: Device info is read through the family's helper. Each mutation here makes some caller read a board with the wrong reader, and each wrong reader is a verdict that is silently wrong: a Roadrunner describe read as sha-less, a Cartographer literal given an invented sha, a screen matched against another type's objects.

mutations.name: a digest needs its range to be comparable
DIGEST_NONE is no digest
mutations.find:
bool(self.digest_algorithm)
            and self.digest is not None
mutations.replace:
self.digest_algorithm is not None
            and self.digest is not None

mutations.name: a family's helper supplies its reader
mutations.find: return reader if reader is not None else KLIPPER

mutations.name: a helper without a reader falls back to Klipper
mutations.find: return reader if reader is not None else KLIPPER

mutations.name: a bare sha is a Roadrunner commit
a dirty Roadrunner build still carries its commit
a Roadrunner knows a dirty build
Cartographer never gets an invented sha
mutations.find:
def running_sha(self, version: str | None) -> str | None:
        return None

mutations.name: a screen type's Klipper prefix comes from its reader
flash_state extracts the sha with the reader it is given
type_status reads through the family's reader
a bulk flash selects through the family's reader
mutations.find:
reader = device_info.reader_for(family)
            # Once per type, not per serial - every board of this type shares
mutations.replace:
reader = device_info.KLIPPER
            # Once per type, not per serial - every board of this type shares
